## 1. Input and actual measurement generator
The incoming channel must be exponentially diamond-close to a positive common-span channel of the form generated by Pauli DATA coefficients of weight <=alpha N on the code, with arbitrary retained auxiliary/bath coefficients and a fixed logical-independent canonical auxiliary input. This is the CHANNEL-level contract supplied by the retirement theorem, not a claim about one state's syndrome distribution. Do not substitute arbitrary DATA/bath correlations having no such logical input factorization.

At each of M<=C_M N grouped sites use the actual separate jumps

    J_b=sqrt(kappa)|b><wait|_pointer tensor P_b^Z,  b=0,1.

All other nominal DATA couplings are off during measurement. The nominal propagator is the product of these onsite instruments and a CPTP auxiliary/bath propagator acting on neither DATA nor pointers. Arbitrary initial correlations may remain. Any extra DATA/pointer coupling, pointer relabeling or calibration error belongs to the bounded incident joint-cb perturbation budget. Well-defined normal propagators are assumed as in the memory theorem.

For a wait-initialized site, the final resolved nominal maps are exactly

    outcome b: (1-exp(-kappa T)) P_b rho P_b,
    outcome wait: exp(-kappa T) rho.

Completed pointer labels are absorbing nominally. This uses an actual pointer read at the endpoint, not access to a fictitious environmental jump record. At that endpoint the DATA may be traced; the output being protected is the entire logical-Z classical label with any external reference.

## 2. Actual joint incomplete-pointer tail
Let B_i=|wait><wait|_i. Direct calculation gives L_nom^*B_i=-kappa B_i and

    L_nom^* product_(i in S)B_i = -kappa |S| product_(i in S)B_i.

Center local HP noise terms, if needed, by subtracting {N_Z^*(I),O}/2. The aggregate is unchanged, local supports are unchanged, and cb norms grow by at most two. This is not a decomposition into separate Lindblad generators; only the actual total evolution must be CPTP.

A term touching K subset S has the operator bound

    N_Z^* product_(i in S)B_i
       <= ||N_Z^*||cb product_(i in S\K)B_i.

Untouched system factors factor out of the joint map even with an arbitrary retained bath. At most q pointer factors are touched, after the fixed grouping constant is included. The incident budget is C eta per pointer. The subset hierarchy therefore gives, on the FULL actual state,

    Tr rho(T) product_(i in S)B_i <= p(T)^|S|,
    p(T)^q=exp(-q kappa T)+(C eta/kappa)(1-exp(-q kappa T)).

This holds uniformly over inputs/references; no detector independence is used. For m=ceil(beta N),

    Pr(number of wait labels >=m)
       <= binom(M,m) p(T)^m
       <= (e C_M p(T)/beta)^m.

Choose a fixed T and then eta so the ratio is strictly below one. This yields delta_wait<=exp(-aN). It controls incomplete pointers only; it does NOT by itself establish logical accuracy.

## 4. Exceptional-site instrument representation and exact logical block form
Read every pointer as an actual classical outcome. Apply, only in the proof, the output filter retaining at most beta N wait labels; default those labels to fixed bits. Fix a retained pointer string and its wait set I. On a Dyson term with insertion support S, every site outside E=S union I undergoes its exact completed ideal Z instrument, with a scalar nominal completion coefficient. On E there can be an arbitrary HP output-bit instrument with arbitrary bath memory.

That last phrase has an explicit algebraic reduction. For a fixed output bit string y_E and any input matrix units |i><j| on DATA_E, write the remaining normal instrument as bath coefficient maps applied to <i|X|j>. This is identical to placing the DATA operator legs

    L_i=|y_E><i|,      L_j=|y_E><j|

before ideal Z measurement on E, retaining the bath coefficient map. Any finite local pointer input/output indices are included in those coefficients. Therefore all output relabelings, arbitrary local effects and interleaved measurement back-action on E are represented by DATA legs supported on E followed by ideal physical Z measurement. This is a linear matrix-element identity, not a CP or stochastic-Pauli reduction.

Compose with each initial common-span coefficient and expand the DATA legs in Pauli operators. Each ket and bra coefficient has weight at most

    t_N=(alpha+q gamma+beta)N+O(1).

For CSS codewords supported on x_l+C_X, a measured physical string x arising from an X^a Z^b coefficient on logical label l differs from that coset by the X part a, of weight <=t_N. A fixed classical decoder correct for all such X errors must label x by l. The same reasoning applies independently on the bra. Consequently a common physical output string cannot receive a term from l!=l', and its grouped output cannot be the wrong label. This proves, after tracing ALL auxiliary outputs, that the truncated filtered HP map has exactly the form

    T(rho_LR)=sum_l c_l |l><l|_out tensor <l|rho_LR|l>_R,  (1)

with real c_l. No independence of c_l from l is required. Requiring 2t_N below both CSS distances, as V1 does, is sufficient. For this full destructive logical-Z conclusion the coset discrimination itself uses only the relevant logical-X separation; the stronger two-distance assumption is harmless.
